name: Node.js
description: Installs Node.js system-wide and declares node_modules as dcc state to preserve packages across runs.

installOnStart.description: Run npm install in the workspace on each container start. Skips workspaces without package.json and projects using another package manager.

version.description: Select the Node.js version to install. Use 'latest', a major like '22', or full semver like '22.14.0'.
